title: C++: Logger Library
description: Build a logging library with log levels and formatted output.

steps.title: Logger with Levels
steps.description: Create a Logger class with enum Level { INFO, WARN, ERROR }. Implement log(Level, string) that prints '[LEVEL]: message'. Test all three levels.
hints: enum class Level { INFO, WARN, ERROR };
Use a static array for level names.

verification.failureMessage: Print messages at all log levels
